scripts.build:static: next build && if [ -f public/_headers ]; then cp public/_headers out/; fi && if [ -f public/_redirects ]; then cp public/_redirects out/; fi && if [ -f vercel.json ]; then cp vercel.json out/; fi && mkdir -p out/_functions && if [ -f "public/_functions/[[path]].js" ]; then cp "public/_functions/[[path]].js" out/_functions/; fi
scripts.release:zip: pnpm run build:static && ZIP_NAME="the-barber-shop-static-build-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M).zip" && rm -f "$ZIP_NAME" && (cd out && zip -r "../$ZIP_NAME" .) && echo "Created $ZIP_NAME"
scripts.deploy:vercel: pnpm run build:static && echo 'Upload out/ directory to Vercel'
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: pnpm run build:static && echo 'Upload out/ directory to Cloudflare Pages'
